source: create an open world 3d game about killing enemies, leveling up, increasing statsamd unlock areas. add a menu where theres a shop system, settings. add a advanced inventory system. add many different swords. make over 100 swords according to levels required to equip them. make the graphics newgen like. make the game extremely big so theres always to do. add cool landscapes, hills and trees and other nature stuff. add armors into the game. make 150 different armors according to levels. make it so theres 5000 levels. max level is 5000. add cool and generic enemies to kill and add bosses. add a shop system. make the ui smaller but big enough to see everything

answers.ask: Extremely big means what - a few connected regions, or something you walk across for ten minutes?
answers.answer: Use a few large connected regions with different landscapes and level-gated areas; keep the first build focused but make the world feel expansive.

answers.ask: Newgen graphics - do you mean photorealistic, or stylized but high fidelity?
answers.answer: Use stylized but high-fidelity newgen graphics, with detailed nature, lighting, landscapes, armor, and sword effects that work well in Roblox.

answers.ask: Is there a safe town players return to, or is the whole world hostile?
answers.answer: Add a safe central town where players can access shops, inventory, settings, and prepare before going into hostile regions.

## Clarifications resolved
- [author] scale — Q: Extremely big means what - a few connected regions, or something you walk across for ten minutes? A: Use a few large connected regions with different landscapes and level-gated areas; keep the first build focused but make the world feel expansive.
- [author] theme — Q: Newgen graphics - do you mean photorealistic, or stylized but high fidelity? A: Use stylized but high-fidelity newgen graphics, with detailed nature, lighting, landscapes, armor, and sword effects that work well in Roblox.
- [author] shape — Q: Is there a safe town players return to, or is the whole world hostile? A: Add a safe central town where players can access shops, inventory, settings, and prepare before going into hostile regions.
- [agent_inferred] region_count — Q: How many connected regions should “a few” mean in the focused first build? A: Three hostile regions surrounding the central town.
- [agent_inferred] enterability — Q: Must the safe-town shops be enterable buildings? A: No; use an outdoor market and preparation plaza so the connected world remains one surface.

## Enriched image prompt
Create a stylized, high-fidelity open-world RPG map centered on one safe preparation town, with three large hostile regions connected around it. Build the town as an outdoor market plaza for weapons, armor, supplies, and player preparation, with visible roads leading into each region. Give each region a different natural landscape of detailed hills, trees, and vegetation, with increasingly dangerous enemy clearings and a distinct boss arena set away from safe travel roads. Mark each region entrance with a highly visible level-gated barrier while preserving the sense of one expansive continuous world. Use dramatic modern lighting and polished Roblox-friendly materials; suggest broad weapon and armor progression through organized displays in town without attempting to show every inventory item in the landscape.

## Genre
The dominant genre is RPG.

## Shape and preset
Use `world-open-biomes`, Open World with Biomes, for three regions whose danger and rewards rise away from the safe center. The preset is Open World & Survival RPG, adapted to one continuous connected map and without player base-building.

## Config requirements
Use `safezone-town` for the protected central town, `social-hub` for its outdoor shop and preparation plaza, `gate-progression` for the three visible level barriers, `hazard-aggro` for enemy and boss clearings, `landmark-focal` for regional orientation, and `terrain-relief` for hills and varied landscapes. The 100 swords, 150 armor sets, 5,000 levels, menus, inventory, settings, and UI sizing are mechanics or content systems rather than additional map geometry.

## Layout requirements
Place `spawner-npc` in encounter clusters inside each of the three hostile regions and in one boss arena per region, all set back from safe roads and outside the town. No hostile spawners belong inside the safe zone.

## Layout components
One central town anchors three connected landscape regions. Three roads leave the plaza, each crossing one level gate into a distinct region with hills, trees, clearings, landmarks, ordinary encounter ground, and one boss arena. Natural ridges form the outer boundary while roads preserve continuous travel. Compose the town and all three regions as one readable world.

## Render order
Use `topdown`: make the connected regional plan authoritative so every gated region remains reachable from the town, then dress the isometric view from it.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
The scale band is large because regional routes, clearings, gates, and town structures must remain legible in the focused first build. The theme is stylized high-fidelity newgen fantasy nature with dramatic lighting and polished equipment displays. Use `tiered` for hills without overhang. Override the shape’s usual `P4` to a single continuous map because the author explicitly required connected regions.
